answers.sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS reserve_assets_usd FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-06-30'

SELECT (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = 'gross contractual redemption' AND report_date = '2025-06-30') - (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = 'company-held tokens not in Treasury wallet' AND report_date = '2025-06-30') AS net_token_liability_usd

SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-06-30') - (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = 'detailed FFR company total liabilities' AND report_date = '2025-06-30') AS company_asset_excess_usd

SELECT (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = 'July release company total liabilities' AND report_date = '2025-06-30') - (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = 'detailed FFR company total liabilities' AND report_date = '2025-06-30') AS release_liability_delta_usd
